outroSources.description: Vinland Saga manga animation 'I have no enemies', 1280x720 30fps, 59 s, warm golden grade, 27 hard cuts. CapCut end card from 56.5 s.
Vinland Saga manga animation 'Heart to Heart', 1280x720 24fps, 26.7 s, very warm golden field shots. Creator logo intro 0.9-3.5 s, black from 23.8 s.
Third-party TikTok edit (creator credit inside the video): dialogue subtitles over ripple-warped golden shots, ~1 s shots, own audio (not 'Meant to Be'). Text cards + TikTok end card from 24 s.
Third-party TikTok edit: Thorfinn golden/blue/forest montage, ~2.5 s shots, own audio. Black + TikTok end card from 23.6 s.
Third-party TikTok outro already synced to 'Meant to Be' (starts at song 48.16 s): 'kindness' dictionary overlay on golden shots. Low resolution (574x450). TikTok end card from 9.8 s.
